text: Large numbers of immigrants here illegally were likely to vote in the 2024 presidential election.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.questionWording: Large numbers of illegal immigrants are likely to vote in the November presidential election
room.note: Asked a month before the election: 17% strongly agree, 16% somewhat agree (34% net, as published); 21% gave no answer.

truthSource.label: Brennan Center for Justice: Noncitizen Voting, The Missing Millions
truthSource.oneLine: Officials in 42 jurisdictions covering 23.5 million votes in 2016 referred about 30 suspected noncitizen votes. Georgia’s 2024 audit found 20 noncitizens among 8.2 million registrants.

lesson.tip: Real cases exist and get shared widely, which makes them feel common. Ask for the rate, not the story: audits find them in the dozens among millions.
